pattern_id: ConfChange silently converted to no-op without error when rejected due to pending change
description: ConfChange silently converted to no-op without error notification when rejected due to pending change
trigger_condition: Application proposes ConfChange while another ConfChange is pending. The new ConfChange is silently converted to no-op entry instead of returning an error.
root_cause: When ConfChange is rejected due to pending change, code converts it to empty entry without notifying the caller. Application believes ConfChange succeeded but it was actually dropped.
fix_approach: Return explicit error when ConfChange is rejected instead of silently converting to no-op.
